Elaine: Heads-up — we have leftover Q3 promo credits tied to eu-west-1 reserved pool that expire in 5 days. Need sweep plan to avoid losing them :grimacing:
Mike: How much are we talking? any invoice candidates?
Elaine: ~€42,300 across three contracts. Mostly promo/marketing grants. One contract is auto-applied, two require manual mapping.
Sanya: Can we apply to upcoming Dedicated reserved invoices or roll to next month? Any policy blocking this?
FinanceOps: Policy: promo credits with explicit contract IDs can be applied to invoices if within expiry window. No rollover. We'll need contract numbers + project tags.
Elaine: I posted quick query to billing to list affected contracts:

```
SELECT contract_id, region, amount, auto_apply FROM promo_credits
WHERE grant_name LIKE '%Q3-promo%' AND expires_at < '2026-04-05'
```

Elaine: Output: C-3312 (eu-west-1, €18,200, manual), C-4477 (global, €14,500, auto), C-5589 (eu-west-1, €9,600, manual)
Ash: For the manual ones, do we have the contract owner contacts? I can open support ticket to cloud provider to apply credits if needed.
Mike: I can reach out to account reps, but we should prefer internal routing: apply to next invoice for the same billing account and tag to dedicated pool.
Sanya: Note: C-3312 is tied to Reserved pool eu-west-1; if we push to a global invoice it'll be mismatched and may get rejected.
FinanceOps: Actionable checklist:
- collect contract IDs & billing account IDs (Elaine)
- confirm owners and get signoff for manual apply (Mike)
- open cloud billing ticket if provider requires (Ash)
- apply credits to invoices before expiry (FinanceOps)

Elaine: I'll compile and post the list tonight. If we can't apply, next step is request for retroactive credit from sales/legal.
BillingBot: Invoice 78921 scheduled, awaiting credit application for C-4477 :bell:
Mike: Pinged Sarah (sales) and Lucas (legal) for quick approval. :thumbsup: 
Sanya: If anyone sees a better place to route credits (e.g., staging accounts with upcoming charges), flag it here.
Elaine: Thanks — aim to have everything applied within 48h to avoid expiry. Will update thread.
FinanceOps: Adding this to weekly billing standup agenda. :spiral_calendar:
